widgetTool.name: show_bill_breakdown_card
widgetTool.description: Shows a donut card on chat of what the latest bill is made of (gas supply, delivery and other lines). Use it after get_bill_breakdown when the caller is on chat and asks what their bill includes; on voice, say the same in short sentences. Pass the card field of get_bill_breakdown as is. Values come only from that tool. No spoken pacing is needed. Call shape: name is always cx-show-bill-breakdown-card and all card fields go inside payload.

name.description: Always exactly cx-show-bill-breakdown-card (the card element this tool renders).

items.description: Bill parts that add up to the total.

label.description: Name of the part, for example Gas supply.

payload.description: The card data. Put every card field inside this object.

textResponseConfig.textResponseInstruction: Write one short sentence naming the largest part and its amount. Do not read the other items.
